subject: Request: Security hiring runway + offer exception for Principal SecEng
body:
From: Sarah Sheridan <sarah@sheridansearch.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate candidate: Alex Khan / expected comp range

Hi Aditya —

Quick intro: Alex Khan just wrapped a final loop for the Principal Security Engineer role (REQ-7891). Senior engineering background (infra + runtime security), recent lead at a cloud infra startup acquired in 2025. He’s excited about Redwood’s unified serving story.

We had a calibration call internally on comp. Alex is targeting $280k base + equity, which is above the published Principal seceng band in the attached comp-band-security-2026.xlsx. He indicated flexibility for total comp around $320k when including equity/bonus.

If the team wants to move quickly we should consider either:
- a narrow comp exception to match base (gap $25–40k), or
- an enriched sign-on / accelerated equity vesting schedule to bridge the gap while staying inside band for base.

Attaching the candidate summary and the job description. Let me know if you want me to hold his availability — he’s weighing another offer with a sign-on window of 7 days.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Sheridan
Partner, Sheridan & Co.
(sheridansearch.com)

---

On Wed, 2 Dec 2026 at 09:05, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Sarah Sheridan <sarah@sheridansearch.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate candidate: Alex Khan / expected comp range

Thanks Sarah — can you hold? I’ve looped in Monica (People Ops) and Lauren (Head of SecEng comp) to evaluate options.

Monica / Lauren — short context: this is for REQ-7891, Principal SecEng. Candidate strong and timeline tight (7d). He’s asking for ~$280k base. Current Principal base band shows midpoint ~240–250k for us (see comp-sheet). We have two levers: base exception or structured sign-on + equity uplift.

Please review attached comp-band-security-2026.xlsx and candidate summary. Need a quick decision by next Tuesday COB.

Proposed initial ask for approvals team: authorize up to $270k base as an exception plus an $40k sign-on, or approve $255k base with accelerated equity tranche (2x standard cliff schedule).

Aditya
Principal, Security Hiring Program
Redwood Inference

---

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: REQ-7891 — budget runway and headcount sourcing

Team —

I pulled the budget for Q1–Q3 2027. We have 3 open security headcount slots in the hiring plan; two are earmarked for GRC and one for SecEng principal/lead. Finance expects headcount spend to remain flat versus plan but we do have limited flexibility in sign-on funds and equity uplifts (special approval required for base above band).

Key constraints:
- Hiring budget runway covers the req if base stays <= $260k.
- Any base > $260k requires Head of Talent + Finance sign-off (email record sufficient).
- Equity uplifts up to +0.15% total comp dilution are OK with approvals via People Ops.

Options I recommend for speed:
1) Approve $265k base (one-time comp exception) + $25k sign-on (fastest to close).
2) Keep base at $255k + $45k sign-on + accelerated vesting (preferred from comp control perspective).

If leadership wants to keep strict banding we can offer the pure band offer and accept potential candidate loss. Given timelines, option 1 shortens time-to-accept.

Monica
Director, People Ops
Redwood Inference

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: REQ-7891 — comp recommendation and escalation path

Aditya / Monica —

I ran the comp-band history and the packet in the drive. My recommendation:
- Offer a base of $260k with a $40k sign-on (split 50/50 cash + restricted stock) and a 4-year equity schedule with one accelerated tranche at 12 months.
- Approve a one-time exception to base ceiling up to $260k (documented here). Any higher requires FVP-level sign-off.

Rationale: this keeps our base band integrity while using sign-on + equity to close the gap. For Principal profiles, we preserve internal equity bands and avoid compressing existing principals.

If everyone is aligned I’ll draft the formal offer and the comp note for the approval log.

Lauren
Head of SecEng Compensation
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: REQ-7891 — finance clearance for sign-on funds

Folks —

Finance is OK to allocate the sign-on pool for this hire under two conditions: 1) we tag the sign-on as a hiring-closing cost and amortize over 18 months; 2) People Ops documents the exception and provides a short memo to Finance within 48 hours.

If People Ops can commit to drafting the memo today I’ll route the finance confirmation to Aditya and Legal for offer prep. We can handle the $40k sign-on under the existing Q1 hiring envelope.

Marcus
Finance Partner — GTM & Security Programs
Redwood Inference

---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, sarah@sheridansearch.com
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: Approve comp package and send offer

Thanks everyone — consensus: proceed with Lauren’s proposal. Action items: 
- Monica: please prepare the short exception memo (base up to $260k + $40k sign-on split cash/equity) and upload to the req folder. Target: today EOD.
- Marcus: once memo is in, please confirm finance routing so Legal can finalize DocuSign.
- Sarah: please hold candidate availability and confirm you’ll accept a draft offer while we finalize legal language.
- Jordan: loop in Legal to include the accelerated tranche clause in the equity schedule.

Goal: get an offer out by Tue 08 Dec COB to meet the candidate’s window. If we miss that window we risk losing to competing offer.

Aditya
Principal, Security Hiring Program
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: REQ-7891-job-desc-principal-seceng.pdf; comp-band-security-2026.xlsx; candidate-summary-alex-khan.pdf; offer-letter-draft-PRINC-2026.docx
